# Removed-artifact registry for VibeWarden.
# Each line is the literal name of an artifact (file, command, etc) that
# used to exist but no longer does. The CI grep guard at
# internal/quality/removed_artifacts_test.go fails when any name appears
# in a scanned file outside the path allowlist defined in that test file.
# To add a new entry:
#   1. Add the artifact name on a new line below.
#   2. If the name legitimately appears in a file outside CHANGELOG.md /
#      decisions/ (e.g. a negative-assertion test or an explanatory doc),
#      add that file's path to pathAllowlist in removed_artifacts_test.go.
